page.notes: Verse 2 begins "Ad reges" with a small woodcut-like numeral; the word "ab" in line 2 and "Hittæum" are read with some uncertainty; "subneruabis" and "curius" are doubtful readings, the latter likely "currus". Catchword "Venit" belongs to verse 7 on the next page.
